Celebrate the season with Miss Dior fragrances, the perfect gift combining floral freshness, gourmand elegance and the timeless couture spirit of Dior.

A festive beauty look inspired by warm cinnamon tones, luminous skin and sparkling nude lips. The eyes are enhanced with Diorshow 5 Couleurs 623 Cinnamon Glaze, while Dior Forever Glow Luminizer 029 Frozen Médaillon adds a radiant, luminous finish.

media:group.media:title: “Christian Dior’s Night in Color”
media:group.media:description:
On a snowy winter’s night in 1949, all is quiet at 30 Avenue Montaigne until the phone rings: Marlene Dietrich needs a new dress… What follows is an imaginary adventure through the House, where familiar objects become unexpected characters and a little holiday magic takes hold.
Drawing on Dior’s history, award-winning French director Sylvain Chomet creates an animated film filled with humor and imagination, with Robert Pattinson narrating and a cast of ambassadors and friends lending their voices to an extraordinary night.
Josh O’Connor as The Chair LaKeith Stanfield as Ron the Director Louis Garrel as Christian Dior Nine d’Urso, Greta Lee and Nadia Tereszkiewicz as The Bees Rihanna as The Star Camille Cottin as Marlene Dietrich
